disposition_reason: Mean ± SD concentrations of Pb, Cd, Cr, Ni and other elements in geophagic soil sticks from six Tanzanian markets are printed in Table 4.

study.design: market survey of geophagic soil sticks with health risk assessment
study.origin: clay dug from ~5 m pits, sun-dried and molded into sticks (locations of pits not stated)
study.market: Mkuyuni and Kirumba (Mwanza), Njombe and Mlangali (Njombe), Mawenzi and Manzese (Morogoro) markets, Tanzania
study.method: Flame AAS (PerkinElmer Analyst-100) after aqua regia plus perchloric acid digestion of oven-dried, 75 µm-sieved soil
study.lod_text: not printed; blanks below detection limit
